get.description: Whether a film can be asked for in a sentence: the model tier reads it (`generate --ask`).

post.description:
Translate a sentence with `generate --ask --dry-run`; nothing is filmed.

The CLI keeps the translation in a JSON file beside the job, which the preview reads.

get.description: The translation a finished preview kept; 404 until it has one.
The picture at grid or preview size; a miss is fetched from Immich and kept.
The playback rendition, streamed by byte range so the preview can seek to the cut's interval.
Where an automation attempt stands, and the run it opened, even a failed one.
What each cache holds on disk.

schema.title: Response Caches Api V1 Caches Get

post.description: Empty one cache; the next run fills it again as it needs.

get.description: The server this install reads, and whether a key is stored for it.

put.description:
Save the server and key to the database, only the ones that changed.

config.yaml and the environment are never written: a value either of them sets is refused
with the name of what sets it, and a key needs IMMICH_MEMORIES_SECRET_KEY to be stored.

post.description: Ask the server who the key belongs to, without saving anything.
Cut this brief with `generate --no-render`; the job ends with the run the cut became.
The command this brief stands for, as the page offers it to copy.

get.description:
The holidays the pipeline resolves: the known ones, named in the page's language, then
the home country's other public holidays by their own name. Any MM-DD works too.

schema.title: Response Holidays Api V1 Holidays Get

get.description: The browser's language, or the one the viewer chose; a missing string falls back to English.
The job running now, for a page that opens mid-cut to join it.

schema.title: Response Active Job Api V1 Jobs Active Get

post.description: Stop the job's child, from this tab or any other.

get.description: Server-sent events: the job's view on every change, until it finishes.
What the child printed, secrets removed: the reason a failed job gives.

post.description: Keep an uploaded MP3, M4A or WAV for renders to use.

get.description: A previewed or uploaded track, for the player.

Everyone Immich has a name for, the names `--person` takes: most pictured first.

The counts are the last people scan's; anyone it has not counted follows alphabetically.

get.description: A person's face crop at avatar size, fetched from Immich once and cached after.

post.description: The owner's word on one picture, kept across runs: never use it, clear its hold, or forget.

get.description: Everyone in the people registry, inner circle first, with what needs curating.

post.description: Add someone Immich has not tagged, or who is never on camera.
Read the library's people again with `people scan`, keeping every answer given.

put.description: Keep this person's role, notes and answers to the graph's guesses.

delete.description: Remove a relationship somebody recorded, and its reciprocal.

get.description: Runs newest first, each with the first pictures its saved cut plays.
One run as `runs show` reads it: outcome, output, delivery, warnings and phase timings.
The retained output of an automatic run, credentials already removed when it was kept.
The cut in the order it plays, each shot with every reason the run recorded for it.
The rendered film, by byte range so the player can seek.

post.description: Generate the music this cut would get with `music preview`, to hear before rendering.

get.description: Every picture the cut saw, in capture order, with its fate and whatever holds it.

Every saved revision of this cut, oldest first.

post.description: Keep the owner's edits as the next revision; 422 names the edit that would not render.

get.description: The stories the cut tells, heaviest first, each with the pictures that carry it.
The provider the sign-in page offers and whether this browser is signed in.
Every setting with its live value and its source, re-read from disk; secrets masked.

post.description:
Save the changed values to the database; config.yaml and the environment are never written.

422 names the setting refused and why; nothing is saved then.

get.description:
The days `discover-days` catalogued, anniversaries due first, then the rest.

A scheduled run only proposes a day on its anniversary; someone at the brief wants a memory
now, so every catalogued day is offered below the due ones. A day the model could not name
is left out: there is nothing truthful to put on its title card.

schema.title: Response Special Days Api V1 Special Days Get

get.description:
Up to twenty candidates and why the others were set aside, from the last discovery.

Discovery reads the library and takes a while; the last list comes back at once and a fresh
one is worked out behind it when it is a day old or `refresh` asks.

post.description: Start the candidate as `auto run` would: a lease, an attempt, the real CLI child.

get.description:
The trips that overlap a year, as `generate` lists them before it cuts one.

Discovery reads the year's GPS and takes a while; the last answer for the year comes back at
once, and a fresh one is worked out behind it when it is a day old or `refresh` asks.
